extraction_audit.class_caveat: Poisson-leaning reading (q≈0, BRρ≈0) is confounded by cross-conductor pooling: positions_lzeros superposes many conductors' zeros, and superposed independent spectra → Poisson regardless of each L-function's true symmetry class (Sp/U/SO all repel). Single-conductor extraction needed to read the true class. See phase34c / false_positive_equivalence_classes.
